body: Quick pass (UMA) @ 58b4c7db: quick gate green (every app suite, 14.4 min), clippy clean after a test-only type alias (mill2d_c re-run green), one golden moved and explained (Drill op added ahead; thread blocks byte-identical), body complete. Kept as a DRAFT on purpose: stacked on #1005. It's flagged ready when #1005 merges and this takes main and is re-gated. The two merge together.

This conflicts with main (37d93ae5). Please `git merge upstream/main` (NeoTech/Camcraft main) into the branch and push. Conflicting files: crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs plus the golden/test lists (golden_cl.rs, mill2d_b/c, operations.rs, solid_law_goldens.rs, drilling/tests.rs, center_cut_owed.rs, ui mod/pages) - ~10 hunks of both-sides test moves around a generate.rs change; merge main and re-apply.

Merged #1005's refreshed head (`origin/issue/894-thread-mill` @ ac1f7aad, which carries upstream/main incl. #1205) into this branch, then `upstream/main` (already contained). New head: d43ccb43.

**Conflicts / resolutions**
- The textual merge was clean: #1045 never calls `root_cutter` / `crest_region` itself; its `thread_entry::judge` call in `generate.rs` sits after #1005's `walls_round` / `crest_region` gate, unchanged. The round-wall rule is untouched.
- Semantic: main's thread fixtures ran a Thread op with nothing drilled ahead, and #992's law now refuses that hole. I adapted the fixtures and left the law alone (commit d43ccb43):
  - `crates/app/tests/hole_wall_flats.rs`: the Thread verdict now tap-drills the declared hole (minor diameter rounded down to the tenth) to z 4 ahead of the thread, in a plate whose hole is modelled to z 4. The octagon still convicts and the 96-gon still verifies clean.
  - `crates/app/tests/posted_gates/thread.rs`: `thread_verdicts` builds the golden from the shared `thread_support` fixture (drill ahead, exactly as `thread_mill.rs` writes the golden) and runs `verification_gate` over the whole program, drill op included. `solid_law_goldens.rs` declares `mod thread_support`. The thread golden is still judged, not moved to `UNJUDGED`.
  - `golden/nc/thread_mill_m8_multi_form.nc`: regenerated. Main's post now ends the drill cycle with `G99` plus `G00 ... Z30`; the thread block is unchanged.
- `git diff upstream/main --stat` lists only the chain's own files.

**Gate**
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: tools, sim, motion and ui ok. In the app step, `hole_wall_flats`, `solid_law_goldens` and `thread_mill` were red before the fixture fix.
- After the fix: `thread_mill` 8/8, `hole_wall_flats` 5/5, `solid_law_goldens` 6/6 and `thread_entry` 5/5 pass.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-tools -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- GitHub now reports MERGEABLE. The PR stays a draft.

Ready for a re-check (/resolve-conflicts check).
